name: Can a garage conversion include a kitchen or just a kitchenette?

mainEntity.name: Can a garage conversion include a kitchen or just a kitchenette?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion can certainly include either a compact kitchenette or a more comprehensive kitchen, depending on your needs, available space, and budget. A kitchenette typically features a sink, small refrigerator, and possibly a microwave or two-burner cooktop, ideal for light meal preparation. A full kitchen would involve more extensive plumbing, electrical, and ventilation systems to accommodate a larger range, oven, and dishwasher. AKN Design Group offers customized solutions, ensuring the design and functionality align with your vision for the guest suite, enhancing its overall value and utility.
